headerDisplay:
Exposes Nest thermostats, Nest Protect smoke/CO alarms, and Nest Temperature Sensors in HomeKit using a Nest Account access token (not Google cookie auth).

How to get the token: [docs/AUTH.md](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-mynest/blob/main/docs/AUTH.md).
footerDisplay: Thermostats are read-only in this version. Protect occupancy is Nest's ~10-minute presence verdict (auto_away), not motion. Treat the access token like a password.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Homebridge log.

accessToken.title: Nest access token
accessToken.description: The access_token value from https://home.nest.com/session while signed in to a Nest Account. Google account JWTs and ya29. OAuth tokens will not work.

allowThermostatControl.title: Allow thermostat control
allowThermostatControl.description: Reserved for a future write path. Thermostats stay read-only in this version even when enabled; the plugin logs a warning at startup.

exposeProtectOccupancy.title: Expose Protect occupancy
exposeProtectOccupancy.description: Publish an occupancy sensor for mains-powered Protects that report Nest auto_away. This is ~10-minute presence, not motion.

exposeProtectTemperature.title: Expose Protect temperature
exposeProtectTemperature.description: Publish temperature and humidity measured by each Nest Protect.

ignoredDeviceIds.title: Ignored device IDs
ignoredDeviceIds.description: Nest device IDs or serial numbers to leave out of HomeKit. IDs appear in the Homebridge log when devices are added.

fieldTest.title: Use Nest field-test servers
fieldTest.description: Point the plugin at home.ft.nest.com / grpc-web.ft.nest.com. Leave off unless you were told otherwise.

diagnosticsInterval.title: Diagnostics interval (seconds)
diagnosticsInterval.description: Seconds between health heartbeats in the Homebridge log. 0 disables (default). Values 1–29 are raised to 30.

structuredLogs.title: Structured diagnostic logs
structuredLogs.description: When diagnostics are enabled, also emit a machine-readable JSON line alongside each human-readable health report.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Emit verbose diagnostics. Tokens are redacted, but review any log before sharing it publicly.
